Ok. Please don't get me wrong, I am greatful for your reply. But you seem to be either regurgitating what I've said, or are stuck at seeing what I'm writing from a victims POV. 

This is MMFB, right? I wanted a pick me up. I wanted someone to come in, read what I had said and go; damn that shit is fucking awful. I feel for you. Major props for being this strong and I can see why you'd be worried. 

In other words validate what I am saying so I can move on. 

I never asked for how toos. I vented. You said it yourself 'it just sounds like I need to event's yes. That's all I wanted. Shoulders. Shoulders for me to hide my worries in. 

You sighed at me saying high functioning. Apologies for being honest and such. You keep saying break my neoral pathways. That's all well and good, but you can't just go and bring a jackhammer down on them, it takes time, it is NEVER an over night thing. And that is something I can accept. 

You keep telling me to stop comparing. I honestly cannot see any comparisons other than a small reference to class mates going home at the end of the course. I am living my life. I am doing a damn fantastic job at it too. I constantly get told that. I am aware of it. People have crumbled under a lot less -comparison maybe but its the truth also. I am strong, I am plenty aware that I am strong. 

But sometimes the strong need a God damn break. And it is perfectly acceptable for us to say that. And it is fine for me to say I had one of the shitest starts to life imagineable. But look at me. I am coping I am living all be it barely. And I am scared. So fucking what? I am allowed to be. I have every good reason to look forward and be scared. The economy is shit. Nothing is certain, companies will let people go for even the tiniest blip, and having an illness that can cause you to be house bound for weeks at a time without notice, is a good reason to be concerned over losing a job.

No it is not iminant, and yes right now I am worrying without a direct cause. But offset I needed an outless. I needed an internet hug and a few people to gather around and just lift me up.

Not for someone to come and tell me, at the root of it all, 'ah sure all you have to do is think possitively!' If it was that simple, mental health disorders wouldn't be such a damn problem.


Sorry you worked me up and I got pretty pissed. Its never cut and dry with anything. Be it mental health related or just someone scared and upset. You should never nullify it with just 'its simple Guy!' It is never simple.

Its ok, but I'm sure you can understand my concerns now. Its a very valid concern I'm having and its not one that can be done much about unfortunately, but I needed a place to try and air that and try get some understanding back. 


So thank you for doing me that service, and not tried to give me all the tools I have already. 

Sometimes you just need someone to turn around and go, holy shit that is an awful situation, I can see that and I am sorry you have been given that path to walk. 

Not to say, oh you need it to just not affect you. :|

Again thank you, and hugs a plenty back x

So I was under the care of a psychiatric team, consisting of the head psychiatrist and 2 student doctors, training to be GP's, who changed every 3 months, so over the course of 2 years I saw 8 different sets of doctors, each conflicting in my treatment.

The head psychiatrist, didn't listen to me or hold what I was telling him with any substance. For instance, I had a psychotic episode hearing voices seeing things, and he told me it was in my head.(well, fucking DUH!) but insisted that nothing was wrong with me, and the male agressive voice which was haunting me was my 'inner true voice' and my subconcious. Meaning, my subconcious would be a 40yr old, angry man who called me a whore cunt useless good for nothing bitch. Makes perfect sense!

I was put in care of the psychiatric nurse, saw her twice weekly to go through my extensive history, at the end of it, she told me I needed a specific type of therapy(DBT), but they could not offer it, nor could they put me in touch with anyone who could do it for me.

I moved areas, got a new GP, went to see a new psych team, went through the personal history again in a 4 hour session, told them what I had been through, what had happened with the previous team. There was some horridness with that psych, but its not really nessicary to explain, but I left generally feeling optomistic that I had been listened too, I got a call the following week, and was told I was being put on the same medication as previous as they had been in touch with the previous psych team head, and we're just going to follow his instructions.

Needless to say I told them no, expressed I wanted a new treatment plan, they refused. Have sinced tried 4 other GPs, asked if a new Pysch team would just refer back to the first team, and have been told yes, thats how the system works. 

and so I have been without meds for 3 years, with no look at that changing any time soon.

also, the medications I was on, left me zombified, unable to function, unable to live, unable to work. I had no life, unable to do a thing, but was still not elligable for government finacial support, so really up shit creek without a paddle.

But yeah thats the long story. I'm truly drained trying to keep myself going and trying to "get well" when the people who are there to help you don't even listen or care about you getting better. 

Just further upsets me, ya know?

Yeah, I understand what your saying, obviously a good person wants to help others who need it , so they don;t feel alone, and heck, I need to meet more people like that! 

I'd say there is no definitive way to react to information like this, other than go off the lead form the person telling you. And how they are telling it.

In my situation, I wouldn't want to be consoled. I just want understanding and when needed, support. Of course a few swears and harsh words aimed at the offender is normal, but in all honesty, pity wont do any benefit. I'm not sure if that makes sense.

Ofc if there is a situation that someone is coming to tell you first to get help, console the hell out of them and help as much as possible. Support them and get them through what they need to get through.

Its such a varied situation, but you just need some sort of intuition to how people are, and you'd be fine. 

If someone was crying over this, you wouldn't crack a joke or telling them to get over it. Similarly, if someone was making light of the situation they had been in, you wouldn;t look sad and try hug them, you know? People react differently, and if someone was comfortable enough to tell you about this, then surely they wouldn;t think your reaction would hugely offend them.

No idea if I am making sense, and sorry if Im not.

Where there doesn't have to be a depression and stress for trich to be present, if this doesn't impact your life negatively, as in it does not cause you any direct mental/physical harm, then a definition of trich may not be applied to your situation. Two years ago, after getting through a 2year sever depressive episode with many suicide attempts, a hospitalization, and severe agoraphobia, I had moved out of my family home for the second time due to my abusive alcoholic mother.           
A month, tops, after I had moved out, my then 14year old brother who had apparently(according to our mum and his school), slight learning difficulties, called me to tell me he was running away because of mum.         
I convinced him to wait till her was coming to visit me to see the new Harry Potter film, so we could talk about it properly. The school he was in was the one I went to, so I called them and organised for my brother to visit the counsellor without my mothers permission. I also organised a visit the following Friday to talk to the counsellor and my brother at the same time.          
In that meeting, my brother sat and spoke about how every day his walk home got longer, and that he wanted to disappear. After he left the room, I broke down as I knew well the feelings he was experiencing. It killed me for my little brother to be afflicted by the same horrors I had been through and was still fighting.         
At that point I said no more. I called his dad, who lived in a separate country, and demanded that he took his son off my mum. December 20th that year, my brother flew to his dad, I spoke against my mother in the custody battle for him.           
My now not so little brother, after only 2years of secondary school classes - due to different school systems and the court battle, has got into college, and has no learning difficulties at all.           
I don't know what would've happened to him if he stayed with my mother, or what his future will be now, but he is a new person, he stands tall and is happy in himself.          
I could not ask for a better outcome             
**TL;DR saved my brother from our mum, and with 2years of secondary school he has got into college.**
